name: KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun®
short_description: A Kuala Lumpur race organized by JomRun on August 16, 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances starting at Padang Merbok.
ai_summary: The KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is set for August 16, 2026, at Padang Merbok, Kuala Lumpur, with a flag-off at 3:30 AM. Organized by JomRun, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, giving participants of varying experience levels a chance to take part. Registration for this Kuala Lumpur race is currently open.

faqs.question: When is the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled for August 16, 2026, and will be held at Padang Merbok in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Participants should note the flag-off time is set for early morning at 03:30 AM, so plan travel and arrival accordingly to ensure a smooth start.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from at this event?
faqs.answer: Runners can select from three distance categories at this event: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options, organized by JomRun, allows both seasoned distance runners and newer participants to find a suitable challenge on race day.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the race held and what time does it start?
faqs.answer: The event takes place at Padang Merbok in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The flag-off is scheduled for 03:30 AM, meaning participants will begin the race very early in the morning before sunrise, which is typical for road races in warmer climates.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the KL Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the KL Half Marathon 2026 Powered By JomRun® is currently open. Interested runners across the 21.1km, 10km, and 5km categories can sign up ahead of the August 16, 2026 event date at Padang Merbok, Kuala Lumpur.
